Canonical Board Fence Spacing & Window Mathematics

Per owner mandate, all board fences default to 4ft. The window spacing math ensures that the horizontal boards provide balanced sightlines, correct ground clearance, and perfect architectural rhythm:

Triple Rail (3-Rail) [Default]

Top board flush with post top. Remaining 2 boards split space into 3 equal windows.

• Interior Space: 42.50″
• Board Count: 3× 5.50″
• Daylight: 31.50″
• Window H: 10.50″
• Board 1: Y = 30.00″
• Board 2: Y = 46.00″
• Board 3: Y = 62.00″
• Ground Gap: 10.50″
Two Rail (2-Rail) [Option]

Rails sit exactly centered in the windows created by triple rail configuration.

• Window 1 Midpoint: 40.75″
• Window 2 Midpoint: 56.75″
• Rail 1: Y = 38.00″
• Rail 2: Y = 54.00″
• Top Reveal: 8.00″
• Rail-to-Rail: 10.50″
• Ground Gap: 18.50″
Quad Rail (4-Rail) [Option]

Top board flush with post top. Additional 3 rails split space into 4 equal quadrants.

• Interior Space: 42.50″
• Board Count: 4× 5.50″
• Daylight: 26.00″
• Quadrant H: 6.50″
• Board 1: Y = 30.00″
• Board 2: Y = 42.00″
• Board 3: Y = 54.00″
• Board 4: Y = 66.00″
• Ground Gap: 6.50″
